a: ~300 awards, $180M total across 15 Physics programs; up to 5-year projects encouraged
dt: Proposals accepted anytime (new consolidated solicitation posted Aug 17, 2026; replaces NSF 23-615 and 23-607). No fixed target dates in the solicitation; see program pages.
e: Faculty at US universities; no PI limit, but NSF discourages multiple related proposals to different programs. CAREER goes through the separate CAREER solicitation. NSF may prefer institutions with lower indirect-cost rates (EO 14332), and awards may include termination-for-convenience terms.
f: NSF Directorate for Mathematical & Physical Sciences, Division of Physics
n: NSF MPS Physics Research Programs (NSF 26-523): AMO-Experiment, AMO-Theory, Quantum Information Science
